request: Pull the CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV) catalog from cisa.gov, enrich with exploit window (days from added-to-due-date), normalized CWE list, ransomware-campaign flag, and run trend analysis by vendorProject. Publish to a 'Prep Agent / 03 - CISA KEV' project on Tableau Server for cyber analysts to track newly catalogued exploits and SLA pressure across vendors.

sources.name: CISA KEV Catalog
sources.description: U.S. Cybersecurity & Infrastructure Security Agency Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV) catalog. Authoritative public list of CVEs with confirmed exploitation in the wild plus federal-civilian-agency remediation deadlines (BOD 22-01 / 26-04). Public, keyless. Refresh: at least daily on CISA's side; we pull weekly.

args.name: KEV Trend
args.features_description: Adds row-level temporal features parsed from dateAdded (year, month, quarter, day_of_week, iso_week). Pure pass-through of CISA KEV records.
args.stats_description: Long-form CISA KEV statistics by vendorProject: monthly new-CVE counts, 90-day rolling counts, year-over-year deltas with pct change, z-score anomalies vs lifetime baseline (|z|>=2.0 flagged is_anomaly=True), lifetime rank/pct_of_total. Use to identify vendors trending in exploit volume.

outputs.name: CISA KEV Detail
outputs.description: Row-level CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog (one row per CVE). Includes cveID, vendorProject, product, vulnerabilityName, dateAdded, shortDescription, requiredAction, dueDate, knownRansomwareCampaignUse, notes, cwe_list (semicolon-delimited), exploit_sla_days (days between dateAdded and dueDate), plus calendar features. Source: cisa.gov/known-exploited-vulnerabilities-catalog. Refresh: weekly.

outputs.name: CISA KEV Stats
outputs.description: Long-form CISA KEV statistics (one row per vendorProject x year x month) with 90-day rolling new-CVE counts, year-over-year deltas + pct change, z-score anomalies vs lifetime baseline, lifetime rank/pct_of_total. Joinable from Tableau on (dimension='vendorProject', value, year, month). Source: CISA KEV catalog.
